title: Versioned decision rubric (System 1 channel)
description: Host-issued rubric that determines a gated proposal's decision. It is plan data, not a hidden constant: the threshold is declared here and every gated proposal echoes it. The digest (rubric_sha256) is the capabilities.fingerprint recipe over this document without the digest field, so the rubric cannot change content without changing digest. Options are closed; the abstention is named, never a third content option. Only 'logits' calibrates and only calibrated confidence authorizes fusion — 'declared' never does.

rubric_id.description: Identity of the rubric version, stable while its content is.

question.description: Typed question shape. Phase 2 pilot: given a new finding and an existing one, are they the same defect?

options.description: Closed answer set. The channel proposes over these; anything else is the named abstention.

abstention.description: The named abstention: the gate ran and there was no usable number. Below threshold is this, never a guess.

thresholds.description: Per-bucket thresholds keyed by '<question>:<option_count>' with a 'default' fallback. A key no answer can produce is rejected (reachability).

confidence_provenance.description: The provenance class this rubric's thresholds calibrate on. Only 'logits' (direct read) calibrates and only calibrated confidence authorizes fusion; 'declared' (the model reported a number as text) never does, so it is not a valid rule here.

digest.description: Optional self-declared digest over the document without this field. If present it must match the recomputed rubric_sha256.
